label: Run
command: go run -ldflags "-s -w -X hump/pkg/version.Version=1.0.0 -X hump/pkg/version.Commit=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) -X hump/pkg/version.Date=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" ./cmd/hump -f dev/hump.yaml -t 9100

label: Build
command: go build -ldflags "-s -w -X hump/pkg/version.Version=1.0.0 -X hump/pkg/version.Commit=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) -X hump/pkg/version.Date=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" -o ./bin/hump ./cmd/hump

label: Test current file (coverage)
command: OUT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hump-cover.html"; gotestsum --format testdox -- -coverprofile=cover.out && gocov convert cover.out | gocov-html > "$OUT" && open "$OUT"; rm -f cover.out

label: Test all (coverage)
command: OUT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hump-cover.html"; gotestsum --format testdox -- -coverpkg=./... -coverprofile=cover.out ./... && gocov convert cover.out | gocov-html > "$OUT" && open "$OUT"; rm -f cover.out

label: Integration: Kafka (coverage)
command: OUT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hump-cover.html"; gotestsum --format testdox -- -count=1 -timeout 30m -run TestPipeline_Kafka_Integration -coverpkg=./... -coverprofile=cover.out ./... && gocov convert cover.out | gocov-html > "$OUT" && open "$OUT"; rm -f cover.out

label: Integration: HTTP (coverage)
command: OUT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hump-cover-http.html"; gotestsum --format testdox -- -tags=integration -timeout 30m -run TestPipeline_HTTP_Integration -coverpkg=./internal/... -coverprofile=cover-http.out ./test/ && gocov convert cover-http.out | gocov-html > "$OUT" && open "$OUT"; rm -f cover-http.out
